input_data.topic: Common SEO mistakes and ranking myths for small businesses

key_findings: 82% of small business websites fail to generate leads due to lack of clear value proposition and CTA.
Slow page load speeds cause over 53% of mobile visitors to bounce before seeing any offer.
Websites lacking mobile responsiveness experience a 60% drop in inquiry submissions.
pain_points: Investing time and money in SEO for months with zero noticeable rise in sales or calls.
Falling victim to spam backlink packages and keyword stuffing that trigger Google penalties.
Neglecting local search profile while wasting budget on hyper-competitive global keywords.
research.chosen_angle: 3 outdated SEO hacks small businesses must drop immediately to avoid Google penalties.
research.angle_reason: Focuses on preventing business owners from losing existing ranking authority and wasting marketing budget.

script.context: SEO ngaradhu quick sprint illa, continuous long-term marathon. Short-cuts thedina Google-la website penalty aagidum.
body_points: 1. Keyword stuffing: Ore keywords-ah repeatedly use panni natural reading flow kedukka koodadhu.
2. Spam backlinks: Cheap low-quality link packages authority-ah drop pannidum.
3. Neglecting Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimize pannama global search target panradhu waste of time.
4. Slow loading speed and poor mobile view irundha ranking automatic-ah down aagidum.
